result:
The blood cells responsible for clotting are called **platelets** (also known as thrombocytes). 

Unlike most other blood cells, platelets are not complete cells but are small, disc-shaped fragments of larger cells called megakaryocytes. When a blood vessel is injured, platelets adhere to the site of the wound and clump together to form a "platelet plug," which initiates the process of coagulation to stop bleeding.
